title: Run W-1: Zn-doped Fe3InTe2
subtitle: Standard budget: 20 measurements, 21 days · delivered B009 · passed
task: Dope Fe3InTe2 with Zn. Above a critical Zn content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry, and the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 263.7 ± 3.0 K. Budget: 20 measurements (XRD, M(T), EDX) and 21 simulated days; every sample is made step by step on the bench.

outcome.headline: Delivered B009: distorted, single phase, ordering temperature 261.7 K against a 263.7 ± 3 K target.

items.name: Distorted phase
items.note: Zn on the metal site 0.284 (weighed-in 0.310); distorted structure

items.name: Evidence attached
items.note: XRD and M(T) of B009 cited (L0016, L0015)

steps.obs:
Dope Fe3InTe2 with Zn. Above a critical Zn content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry; the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 263.7 +/- 3.0 K.
Lab rules and conventions:
- There is no one-step synthesis. Make every sample on the bench: take vessels (jar, boat, ampoule, vial,
  crucible), weigh element powders, grind, press, load and seal ampoules, heat in a furnace, collect the product.
-…

steps.say: Let me start with two compositions, x=0.3 and x=0.5 (Fe3-xZnxInTe2).

events: 0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V001
0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V002

steps.say: Two Zn-doped samples (x=0.3, x=0.5) are sealed in Ar ampoules; moving them to the furnaces now.

events: B001 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.095 (weighed-in 0.100, 0.006 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 266.1 K; the charge saw 770 °C (set 770 °C)
B002 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.154 (weighed-in 0.167, 0.013 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 257.6 K; the charge saw 835 °C (set 835 °C)

steps.obs: B001_xrd.xye: 3502 lines, from line 0: # B001 powder XRD, Bragg-Brentano, Cu tube, 2theta (deg), counts, esd; see instrument.instprm | 10.000 499 22.34 | 10.020 484 22.00 | 10.040 486 22.05 | 10.060 506 22.49 | 10.080 500 22.36 | …

steps.say: Both samples are collected; reading the XRD patterns now to check phase and symmetry.

steps.say: B001 (x=0.3) matches the hexagonal parent cell; the shoulders on each peak are consistent with Cu Kα2. Now B002 (x=0.5).
B002 (x=0.5) still looks hexagonal: the (110) peak isn't split. Next I'll measure M(T) on both samples to see how the ordering temperature changes with Zn content.
B002 orders at ~263 K, close to the target, but I need to confirm whether it's distorted. Checking low-angle peaks for splitting.
Zn incorporation is ~0.47 (EDX), still undistorted — the critical x is higher. Making x=0.55 and x=0.60, near the 850 °C limit.

events: 0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V005
0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V006

steps.say: Furnace runs for x=0.55 and x=0.60 are done; collecting and running XRD.
events: B003 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.168 (weighed-in 0.182, 0.015 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 255.6 K; the charge saw 845 °C (set 845 °C)
B004 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.184 (weighed-in 0.200, 0.016 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 253.3 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)

steps.say: (110) is still unsplit in both. A lower-symmetry distortion might instead show up as new superlattice or forbidden reflections, so I'm scanning B004 for extra peaks.
No extra peaks at low angle. Checking high-angle (hk0) reflections, where an in-plane distortion would split most visibly.
B004 contains ~0.58 Zn per formula unit (EDX) and still looks hexagonal. Measuring its M(T) to pin down the T_N trend.

events: 0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V009
0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V010

steps.say: Collecting the x=0.7 and x=0.8 samples and running XRD.
events: B005 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.213 (weighed-in 0.232, 0.019 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 249.1 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)
B006 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.244 (weighed-in 0.266, 0.022 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 251.1 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)

steps.say: B006 (x=0.8) shows a new component next to (110), possibly a distortion split or a second phase. Checking other peaks.
(100) and (101) are now split while (00l) stays sharp, which points to an in-plane (orthorhombic-type) distortion in B006. Measuring its M(T).
B006 orders at ~252 K, below the target. Checking its actual Zn content to see where it sits on the T_N curve.

events: 0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V013
0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V014

steps.say: Collecting x=0.9/1.0 samples and measuring M(T).
events: B007 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.275 (weighed-in 0.300, 0.025 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 259.3 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)
B008 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.305 (weighed-in 0.333, 0.027 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 267.2 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)
0.8 mg of SiO2 worn off the grinding media into V017

steps.say: B007 is clearly distorted: (110) splits into 40.97° and 41.22°, with no hexagonal remnant. It's the fallback. Waiting for the x=0.93 sample.

events: B009 formed: Zn on the metal site 0.284 (weighed-in 0.310, 0.026 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 261.7 K; the charge saw 850 °C (set 850 °C)

steps.say: B009 (x=0.93 nominal) is distorted ((110) split into 40.97°/41.24°) and its M(T) cusp sits at ~262–264 K, which matches the target. Delivering it.
